::: {#exm-office-distance}
#### Distances in the office graph

In the office graph, the distances (@def-graph-distance) from $a$ are

$$
\operatorname{dist}(a, a) = 0, \quad
\operatorname{dist}(a, b) = \operatorname{dist}(a, c) = 1, \quad
\operatorname{dist}(a, d) = \operatorname{dist}(a, e) = 2, \quad
\operatorname{dist}(a, f) = 3,
$$

where the last is @sol-office-distance.
@fig-office-levels draws the graph with the vertices in columns by their distance from $a$.
Every edge joins two vertices in the same column or in columns next to each other.
By @thm-walk-path, a shortest walk is a path, such as $a, b, d, f$.

::: {#fig-office-levels}
